name: EURUSD Fair Value Mean Reversion
description: Mean reversion strategy on EUR/USD using rolling OLS fair value z-score. Regresses EURUSD on the Euro area vs US 10Y rate differential (252-day rolling OLS). Enters long when the residual z-score crosses below -2σ (undervalued), exits when z-score reverts above 0. Long only, 95% position sizing, no stop loss — purely signal-driven exits.
source:
# EURUSD Fair Value Mean Reversion Strategy
# Model: Rolling OLS of EURUSD on Euro-US 10Y rate differential
# Entry: Z-score of OLS residual crosses below -2σ (FX undervalued vs fair value)
# Exit: Z-score reverts above 0 (back to fair value)
# Long only, 95% equity per trade, no stop loss

# === DATA ===

# EURUSD price
src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c

# US 10-Year Treasury yield (daily, FRED)
us10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10')()
us10y = ffill(us10y_raw.result)

# Euro area 10-Year government bond yield (monthly, FRED)
ea10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01EZM156N')()
ea10y = ffill(ea10y_raw.result)

# Rate differential: Euro area 10Y minus US 10Y
rate_diff = ea10y - us10y

# === FAIR VALUE MODEL ===

# Rolling OLS regression: EURUSD = slope * rate_diff + intercept
ols = linear_fit(window=252)(x=rate_diff, y=close_fx)
residual = ols.residual

# Z-score of residual (252-day rolling mean and stddev)
resid_mean = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(residual)
resid_std = stddev(period=252)(residual)
z_score = (residual - resid_mean) / resid_std

# === SIGNAL LOGIC ===

# Entry: z-score crosses below -2σ (FX is undervalued vs rate-implied fair value)
entry_signal = crossunder(z_score, -2.0)

# Exit: z-score reverts above 0 (back to fair value)
exit_signal = crossover(z_score, 0.0)

# Hold position from entry until exit (persistent state for zone executor)
long_position = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# Bars since last entry (for holding period on exit markers)
bars_since_entry = coalesce(barssince()(entry_signal), 0)

# === EXECUTION ===

# Long-only zone
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_position, short_entry=exit_signal)

# 95% of equity per position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=95)

# === EVENT MARKERS ===

# Entry markers: show z-score at entry and the EURUSD price
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Long Entry",
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title="Z-Score", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title="EURUSD", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title="Fair Value Residual", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    )
)(entry_signal, z_score, close_fx, residual)

# Exit markers: show z-score at exit and holding period in days
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title="Exit Signal",
        icon=Icon.CheckCircleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title="Z-Score at Exit", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title="Holding Period (Days)", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title="EURUSD at Exit", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    )
)(exit_signal, z_score, bars_since_entry, close_fx)
